disambiguation: Disambiguation: Pacta by Fractal Neurons (https://pacta.wtf, pacta.base.eth, io.github.Fractal-Neurons/pacta) is the EVM DeFi control-plane, Safe multisig, and timelock verification registry — unrelated to pactaprotocol.org (commercial escrow) or RMI PACTA (climate assessment).

lookup.note: Name lookup first: if you only have a protocol or token name (e.g. Aave, Ethena, USDe, Moonwell, kUSD), call pacta_lookup_protocol (or GET https://pacta-x402.pacta.workers.dev/v1/protocols/lookup?q=<name>) to resolve its verified record: canonical slug and page URL, checksummed primary contract and controller, classification with its evidence basis (eas_attested: Base-EAS-attested, documentation compared; rpc_observed: on-chain control plane pinned over JSON-RPC, documentationComparison not_assessed; briefs), and preflightArgs {chain, address} for pacta_check_preflight. 316 protocols + 17 briefs, answered in memory with no RPC; free in every pricing mode; an empty query lists the catalog. Catalog: https://pacta.wtf/api/v1/lookup.json.

x402.gatewaySettlementGuard: In x402_paid mode the gateway verifies every settlement on Base before releasing the product: eth_getTransactionReceipt must show status 0x1 and canonical USDC Transfer(payer -> payTo 0xcA4E2ff22B69A7284210c47BdeE21Aac1269da09) logs summing to at least the route price, and replays are rejected on a best-effort basis (402 replay_settlement_tx) via synchronous same-isolate state and non-atomic eventually-consistent KV used_tx:<txHash>; concurrent cross-isolate races are not globally atomic without Durable Objects. Otherwise the product is withheld: 402 unconfirmed_or_reverted_settlement_tx / insufficient_onchain_usdc_transfer, or 502 settlement_rpc_unavailable when no Base RPC answers.
